stories.title: MODIFY-COLUMN v0023 -- strip stale inline data_source CHECK (BL-021)
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: before writing the fix, read the current v0023 body AND introspect (information_schema) the actual data_source column def + CHECK on every affected table (calibration_sessions, connection_log, profiles, realtime_data, statistics) on a real MariaDB; confirm inline (name==column) vs table-level

[ATLAS RULING 2026-07-13] Replace v0023's DROP with per-table MODIFY COLUMN that strips the inline CHECK while PRESERVING the full INTROSPECTED column def (a bare MODIFY VARCHAR(16) silently resets collation) -- the 5 tables are VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'real'; introspect+preserve, do not hardcode. DROP CHECK is NOT MariaDB syntax (1064); DROP CONSTRAINT can't drop an inline CHECK (1091)

Branch inline-vs-table: inline (name==column) -> MODIFY COLUMN (strip CHECK); table-level (ck_*) -> DROP CONSTRAINT. Keep v0023's existing discovery + post-probe (Atlas: sound). Today all 5 are inline
Applied to EVERY affected data_source table; idempotent/re-runnable (re-run after success = no-op, no CHECK to strip); replays clean + resumes at v0023 (0018-0022 already applied on prod)

Tests: fixture table with the stale inline data_source CHECK -> after v0023 the CHECK is gone AND the col def (collation/default/nullability/length) is preserved AND the table accepts data_source='foreign'; re-run = no-op. Real-MariaDB per US-464 where available; targeted+synchronous+committed in-iteration [ATLAS TIGHTEN-1] the in-loop hermetic test is SQLite/create_all and CANNOT reproduce 1091/1064/inline-CHECK semantics -- a green in-loop test does NOT validate the MariaDB DDL fix (the 4-cycle trap); US-464's real-MariaDB test is sequenced AFTER this story. TRUE acceptance = the live deploy resuming clean at v0023 on real MariaDB (Atlas pre-proved MODIFY COLUMN strips the inline CHECK, no 1091/1064).

validationCriteria.action: run v0023 against a table carrying the stale inline data_source CHECK (VARCHAR(16) utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'real')
validationCriteria.outcome: CHECK removed; column def fully preserved (collation/default/nullability/length); table now accepts data_source='foreign'; no 1091 / no 1064

validationCriteria.action: re-run v0023 after a successful apply
validationCriteria.outcome: no-op, no error, no data_source CHECK present

validationCriteria.action: run v0023 across all 5 affected tables
validationCriteria.outcome: each inline CHECK stripped; migration chain resumes + completes at v0023

validationCriteria.action: apply v0023 on the real server deploy (real MariaDB 11.x) -- NOT the SQLite/create_all in-loop test
validationCriteria.outcome: migration chain resumes clean at v0023 and completes; this real-MariaDB pass is US-463's acceptance -- a green in-loop test is NOT sufficient validation

conditionalOutcomes: if a table's data_source CHECK is table-level (ck_*) rather than inline -> use DROP CONSTRAINT for that one (the branch handles both); today all 5 are inline
if introspection shows a column def differing from utf8mb4_unicode_ci / DEFAULT 'real' -> preserve the ACTUAL introspected def, never assume
stories.goal: As the deploy pipeline, I want v0023 to strip each table's stale inline data_source CHECK via a definition-preserving MODIFY COLUMN, so the migration applies on real MariaDB (where DROP CONSTRAINT can't drop an inline CHECK and DROP CHECK is not valid syntax) and the V0.29.10 deploy completes.

stories.title: TD-055 real-MariaDB migration-chain CI test (A-10 drift class)
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: identify the current server-migration test path (the SQLite/create_all route that green-passed BL-020 + BL-021) and what real-MariaDB test infra exists (testcontainers / service); confirm the exact gap

[ATLAS RULING 2026-07-13 -- TD-055 graduates to funded] a test applies the FULL pending migration chain against a REAL MariaDB instance (testcontainer or equivalent), NOT SQLite / create_all -- create_all is precisely what shipped BL-020 + BL-021 green [ATLAS TIGHTEN-2] pin the testcontainer to the PROD MariaDB major (11.x, matching 11.8.6) -- the BL-021 quirk is MariaDB-version-sensitive; a wrong-version container could green-pass a prod-failing migration.

the test provably CATCHES both classes: BL-020 (FK drift / missing-FK) AND BL-021 (inline-CHECK DROP CONSTRAINT failure) -- seed the drifted schema state + assert the chain applies clean or fails loudly (never green over a broken DB)
wired into the test suite / CI (marked @pytest.mark.integration|slow if it needs a container); documents the TD-055 lineage (BL-019 -> BL-020 -> US-459 theater-trap -> BL-021, Atlas's 4th cycle)

validationCriteria.action: run the migration-chain test against a real MariaDB seeded with a drifted schema (missing FK and/or stale inline CHECK)
validationCriteria.outcome: the test FAILS loudly on the drift (would have caught BL-020 + BL-021), does not green-pass
the full chain applies and the test passes

conditionalOutcomes: if real-MariaDB (testcontainer) infra cannot run in current CI -> deliver the test runnable locally against a MariaDB service + document the CI-enablement follow-up; do NOT silently skip (that is the create_all trap again)
stories.goal: As the maintainer, I want a test that applies the full migration chain against a REAL MariaDB (not SQLite/create_all), so the migration-vs-live-DB drift class (BL-019/020/021) is caught in CI instead of one deploy at a time.
